description: List saved reusable hashtag sets in this brand (up to 100), optionally filtered to one network. Each set returns normalized hashtags, a ready-to-paste text string and platform count advisories. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

network.description: Optional network key such as "instagram", "linkedin" or "x" to filter saved hashtag sets.

name: hashtag_sets_list
title: List hashtag sets
